messages:
Rina (People Ops): Quick note 01 All-hands this Friday 10:30am PT. Short format (30m). Drop agenda items or questions here or add to the live doc: https://docs.google.com/quarterly-allhands-notes

Rina (People Ops): Draft agenda (30m):
- 10:30  10:35  Exec snapshot (Evan)
- 10:35  10:45  Product & roadmap highlights (Priya)
- 10:45  10:50  Infra & capacity updates (Diego)
- 10:50  10:55  Recent incident postmortem + mitigations (Lina)
- 10:55  11:00  Live Q&A (timeboxed)

Rina (People Ops): Accessibility: captions on, recording + transcript will be posted. If you need an alternate time, DM me.

Evan (CEO): Will call out hiring priorities (infra, platform) and partner integrations. Also very quick note on company priorities for next quarter.

Priya (Prod): Im planning a 6-min demo of the new customer onboarding flow and the feature-flag rollout timeline. Need screen share and 1-2 slides.

Diego (Infra): Can someone add a single slide for the new instance-type benchmarks? I have numbers that show peak throughput improvements.

Lina (SRE): Ill do a 3-min incident snapshot  misrouted model versions causing elevated error rates. Short root cause + fixes + where to find the full postmortem.

Kai (Design): Will upload a short clip of the new UX microcopy. 30s.

Rina (People Ops): Please upload slides to the shared folder by Thu EOD. If you plan to demo, test audio/video with MeetBot.

MeetBot: Test meeting connection available: https://meet.test/redwood-allhands. Run test between 9-10am Fri.

Diego (Infra): Adding perf graphs to the notes now.

Evan (CEO): Request: 2 minutes at the end for 3 top company-wide asks (hiring, reliability, partner launch).

-- (after meeting) --

Rina (People Ops): Thanks everyone  recording + notes up: https://drive.google.com/quarterly-allhands/recording.mp4 and https://docs.google.com/quarterly-allhands-notes?action=post

Rina (People Ops): TL;DR takeaways:
- Evan: Company focus on reliability and partner integrations; hiring ramp planned for infra and platform teams.
- Priya: Onboarding flow shipping phased rollout starting May 10th; feature flag gating will allow canary customers.
- Diego: New instance types reduced median tail latency by ~9% in internal tests; perf deck linked.
- Lina: Incident recap  misrouted model versions due to incomplete deploy validation; mitigation = new pre-deploy validation step + monitoring alert (see postmortem).

Rina (People Ops): Actions (owner / due):
- Priya: Publish rollout schedule + customer comms draft (due 2026-05-02)
- Diego: Share benchmark deck + instance recommendation (due 2026-04-28)
- Lina: Finalize postmortem doc + PR for runbook changes (due 2026-04-26)
- Kai: Upload microcopy video + assets to library (due 2026-05-05)
- Evan: Follow-up note on hiring plan & reqs (due 2026-05-04)

Priya (Prod): Uploaded demo clip and the feature-flag playbook. Link in notes.

Diego (Infra): Perf deck uploaded, will follow up with SRE on rollout cadence.

Lina (SRE): Postmortem posted: https://github.com/redwood/postmortems/incident-2026-04-21. Runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/412.

Kai (Design): Assets uploaded to design drive.

Evan (CEO): Thanks team  appreciated the concise updates. I'll send the hiring follow-up after I sync with recruiting.

Rina (People Ops): If we missed any follow-ups, reply here and Ill add. Closing thread and will convert open items into Asana tasks. :white_check_mark:

CalendarBot: Event: Quarterly All-Hands recorded. Meeting materials in shared folder.
